text: Before the first heartbeat of time, what was the nature of the universe?

responses.text: A perfect, silent blueprint waiting to be enacted.
A screaming, fertile chaos of pure potential.
A single, conscious thought in the mind of the Divine.
An echoing, hollow silence that owed nothing to no one.

text: You stand in a crowded marketplace. What is your unspoken role?

responses.text: The silent guardian watching the perimeter for threats.
The radiant presence that draws others into your orbit.
The shadow on the wall, seeing all but remaining unseen.
The one whispered about for questioning the status quo.

text: When the tapestry of your life is finally finished, what should the central image be?

responses.text: A throne or a city that stands long after I am gone.
A mirror reflecting a perfectly clear and peaceful sky.
A figure stepping through a door into a blinding, new light.
A drop of water falling into a vast, shimmering ocean.
